snippet.title: Ethereal Odyssey New Metroidvania Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
The world was once a dream is now a prison, shifting with every step. What waits beyond the veil? 

Ethereal Odyssey is 2D metroidvania, rewarding curiosity and discovery, where secrets in every corner. Journey through an hand-drawn world to uncover emotions and memories. Each dream is a   unique emotional landscape, rich with symbolism, mysterious creatures, and hidden secrets.
The game is in development of indie game dev studio.

Join our community: https://www.patreon.com/c/KU3
Official site: https://eo.ku3.dev
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3458930/Ethereal_Odyssey/

#EtherealOdyssey #indiegames #metroidvania
